headline: On last trading session, Indian markets recovered led by banking and IT stocks; market closed today for weekend.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying helped Indian benchmark indices extend a 4-week rally to 9-month highs.
Global sell-off in AI stocks and US Fed rate hike signals created downward pressure in recent sessions.
Midday recovery in banking, auto, and IT stocks supported buying interest in previous trading sessions.
Commodity market fluctuations saw gold drop to its lowest level of 2026 while Kotak highlighted copper as attractive.
whatHappening: In the last session on 20 November 2026, Sensex and Nifty 50 recovered midday led by banking and IT stocks after opening lower.
NSE stock price zoomed 35% from its October low, rallying 5% on heavy trading volume.
Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points on 19 November as Nifty reclaimed the 25,500 mark.
Upcoming mainboard and SME IPOs scheduled for the week include Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries and Foodlink F&B.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today, Sunday 22 November, due to the weekend and will reopen on Monday.
In recent sessions, Sensex and Nifty touched 9-month highs driven by record FII buying despite global AI sell-offs.
Last trading session saw benchmark indices rebound midday supported by strength in banking, auto, and IT shares.
